# Original transcription of encoding facts, SH-1/SH-2 Programming Manual §5.
# Each line: mnemonic/form, 16-bit pattern; n/m/i/d are variable bits.
# SH-2 only: no SH-3/SH-4 extensions, no SH-1-only behaviors.
MOV-imm 1110nnnniiiiiiii
MOV-reg 0110nnnnmmmm0011
MOVB-indirect-load 0110nnnnmmmm0000
MOVW-indirect-load 0110nnnnmmmm0001
MOVL-indirect-load 0110nnnnmmmm0010
MOVB-indirect-store 0010nnnnmmmm0000
MOVW-indirect-store 0010nnnnmmmm0001
MOVL-indirect-store 0010nnnnmmmm0010
MOVB-postincrement 0110nnnnmmmm0100
MOVW-postincrement 0110nnnnmmmm0101
MOVL-postincrement 0110nnnnmmmm0110
MOVB-predecrement 0010nnnnmmmm0100
MOVW-predecrement 0010nnnnmmmm0101
MOVL-predecrement 0010nnnnmmmm0110
MOVB-indexed-load 0000nnnnmmmm1100
MOVW-indexed-load 0000nnnnmmmm1101
MOVL-indexed-load 0000nnnnmmmm1110
MOVB-indexed-store 0000nnnnmmmm0100
MOVW-indexed-store 0000nnnnmmmm0101
MOVL-indexed-store 0000nnnnmmmm0110
MOVB-displaced-load 10000100mmmmdddd
MOVW-displaced-load 10000101mmmmdddd
MOVL-displaced-load 0101nnnnmmmmdddd
MOVB-displaced-store 10000000nnnndddd
MOVW-displaced-store 10000001nnnndddd
MOVL-displaced-store 0001nnnnmmmmdddd
MOVB-gbr-load 11000100dddddddd
MOVW-gbr-load 11000101dddddddd
MOVL-gbr-load 11000110dddddddd
MOVB-gbr-store 11000000dddddddd
MOVW-gbr-store 11000001dddddddd
MOVL-gbr-store 11000010dddddddd
MOVW-pc-relative 1001nnnndddddddd
MOVL-pc-relative 1101nnnndddddddd
MOVA 11000111dddddddd
MOVT 0000nnnn00101001
SWAPB 0110nnnnmmmm1000
SWAPW 0110nnnnmmmm1001
XTRCT 0010nnnnmmmm1101
EXTUB 0110nnnnmmmm1100
EXTUW 0110nnnnmmmm1101
EXTSB 0110nnnnmmmm1110
EXTSW 0110nnnnmmmm1111
ADD-reg 0011nnnnmmmm1100
ADD-imm 0111nnnniiiiiiii
ADDC 0011nnnnmmmm1110
ADDV 0011nnnnmmmm1111
SUB 0011nnnnmmmm1000
SUBC 0011nnnnmmmm1010
SUBV 0011nnnnmmmm1011
NEG 0110nnnnmmmm1011
NEGC 0110nnnnmmmm1010
CMPEQ-reg 0011nnnnmmmm0000
CMPEQ-imm 10001000iiiiiiii
CMPHS 0011nnnnmmmm0010
CMPGE 0011nnnnmmmm0011
CMPHI 0011nnnnmmmm0110
CMPGT 0011nnnnmmmm0111
CMPPL 0100nnnn00010101
CMPPZ 0100nnnn00010001
CMPSTR 0010nnnnmmmm1100
DT 0100nnnn00010000
DIV0U 0000000000011001
DIV0S 0010nnnnmmmm0111
DIV1 0011nnnnmmmm0100
MULL 0000nnnnmmmm0111
MULUW 0010nnnnmmmm1110
MULSW 0010nnnnmmmm1111
DMULUL 0011nnnnmmmm0101
DMULSL 0011nnnnmmmm1101
MACL 0000nnnnmmmm1111
MACW 0100nnnnmmmm1111
AND-reg 0010nnnnmmmm1001
AND-imm 11001001iiiiiiii
ANDB 11001101iiiiiiii
OR-reg 0010nnnnmmmm1011
OR-imm 11001011iiiiiiii
ORB 11001111iiiiiiii
XOR-reg 0010nnnnmmmm1010
XOR-imm 11001010iiiiiiii
XORB 11001110iiiiiiii
NOT 0110nnnnmmmm0111
TST-reg 0010nnnnmmmm1000
TST-imm 11001000iiiiiiii
TSTB 11001100iiiiiiii
TASB 0100nnnn00011011
SHLL 0100nnnn00000000
SHLR 0100nnnn00000001
SHAL 0100nnnn00100000
SHAR 0100nnnn00100001
SHLL2 0100nnnn00001000
SHLL8 0100nnnn00011000
SHLL16 0100nnnn00101000
SHLR2 0100nnnn00001001
SHLR8 0100nnnn00011001
SHLR16 0100nnnn00101001
ROTL 0100nnnn00000100
ROTR 0100nnnn00000101
ROTCL 0100nnnn00100100
ROTCR 0100nnnn00100101
BF 10001011dddddddd
BT 10001001dddddddd
BFS 10001111dddddddd
BTS 10001101dddddddd
BRA 1010dddddddddddd
BSR 1011dddddddddddd
BRAF 0000mmmm00100011
BSRF 0000mmmm00000011
JMP 0100mmmm00101011
JSR 0100mmmm00001011
RTS 0000000000001011
RTE 0000000000101011
TRAPA 11000011iiiiiiii
LDC-SR 0100mmmm00001110
LDC-GBR 0100mmmm00011110
LDC-VBR 0100mmmm00101110
LDCL-SR 0100mmmm00000111
LDCL-GBR 0100mmmm00010111
LDCL-VBR 0100mmmm00100111
LDS-MACH 0100mmmm00001010
LDS-MACL 0100mmmm00011010
LDS-PR 0100mmmm00101010
LDSL-MACH 0100mmmm00000110
LDSL-MACL 0100mmmm00010110
LDSL-PR 0100mmmm00100110
STC-SR 0000nnnn00000010
STC-GBR 0000nnnn00010010
STC-VBR 0000nnnn00100010
STCL-SR 0100nnnn00000011
STCL-GBR 0100nnnn00010011
STCL-VBR 0100nnnn00100011
STS-MACH 0000nnnn00001010
STS-MACL 0000nnnn00011010
STS-PR 0000nnnn00101010
STSL-MACH 0100nnnn00000010
STSL-MACL 0100nnnn00010010
STSL-PR 0100nnnn00100010
CLRT 0000000000001000
SETT 0000000000011000
CLRMAC 0000000000101000
NOP 0000000000001001
SLEEP 0000000000011011
